embed_diagnosis: Raw V4.2f DEX analysis of EpisodesActivity.W1 proved that source.type=embed is not passed to Q0/S0 or DW Player. It launches EmbedActivity with extras url and size. EmbedActivity enables JavaScript and DOM storage, accepts first/third-party cookies, uses size as Referer when it starts with http, enables file access and JavaScript windows, and loads the provider URL in a WebView.
embed_fix: The integration now mirrors that original path inside a full-screen in-app WebView dialog. Normal quick/HD/multi-quality sources still resolve to MX; embed sources remain WebView playback exactly because that is the original Drama World behavior.
adm_handoff: ADM receives the already-resolved URL through an ACTION_VIEW intent scoped to com.dv.adm, plus filename and available Referer/Cookie/User-Agent context; older ADM editor component names are fallback-only.
previous_quick_hd_phone_test: User reported quick-play, HD, multi-quality and downloads working after the quick/HD fix; remaining reported failure was embed playback.
known_limitations: This embed build compiled and signed successfully but the new embed path itself still needs the user's real-phone test. Normal non-embed playback keeps the already phone-tested quick/HD logic.
